direction: Original creepy-cute spacecraft equipment: whirring, humming, tactile and slightly organic. The previous keyboard-like pitched sound bank was explicitly rejected.
generation_method: Text-to-sound AI, not the rejected oscillator generator
trial_result: Public webpage displayed four Generation candidates after submitting ship_idle prompt. No purchase, signup or subscription. Auditory quality and release rights are not approved; no clips integrated.
reference_limit: Current browser tools expose playback controls and visual state, not reliable audio listening by the assistant. Do not claim to have heard Spore gameplay or these drafts.

prompts.prompt: A small alien spacecraft hovering nearby. Continuous warm anti-gravity hum layered with a fine rotating mechanical whirr and soft moving air. Subtle irregular vibration gives it a living, tactile quality. Restrained and smooth, suitable for long gameplay sessions. Isolated engine sound, no music, melody, bells, beeps, voices or bouncing pitch. Steady eight-second loop, no startup or shutdown.
prompts.visual_pairing: Soft engine-core glow, faint continuous exhaust motes; intensity rises with actual thrust.

prompts.prompt: Close-up propulsion sound from a compact alien exploration ship under steady thrust. Dense smooth low hum, fast finely textured turbine whirr, soft pressurized-air movement. Weight and energy without a roaring jet or musical tone. Continuous stable eight-second loop. No melody, bells, beeps, speech, percussion, startup or ending.
prompts.visual_pairing: Longer exhaust plume and faster particle flow driven by thrust, capped emission budget.

prompts.prompt: One compact alien ship instrument engaging: a soft tactile latch, a very brief finely textured servo whirr, and a muted electrical settling sound. Crisp, intimate and satisfying at low volume. Single event under half a second with a clean ending. No musical note, melody, bell, chime, spring bounce, cartoon pop, voice or long reverb.
prompts.visual_pairing: Brief tool-icon illumination and tiny instrument charge pulse, rather than a large world explosion.

prompts.prompt: An alien survey instrument scanning continuously: a soft airy electromagnetic hum with fine rotating granular texture and gentle irregular modulation. Curious and precise, slightly organic. Quiet continuous four-second loop. No sonar ping, musical melody, keyboard notes, ringing bell, voice or percussion.
prompts.visual_pairing: Sweep rings across the scanned target and fine flowing beam particles; stop immediately on cancellation.

prompts.prompt: A small spacecraft tractor field holding an object: warm low electromagnetic hum, softly fluttering pressure and fine vibrating mechanical texture. A contained physical force, not music. Smooth four-second loop without onset or ending. No beeps, melody, springy pitch bend, bells, speech or explosions.
prompts.visual_pairing: Motes travel toward the ship along the beam; their motion and loop stop together.

user_review: User liked Generations 1, 2 and 3; Generation 3 is the preferred engine candidate. Preserve all three for potential ship upgrade/class variants. Generation 4 is not approved.
